_note: The kinds of health payment that are "paid to effect or to keep in force the health insurance" of a person (s.126(7), quoted in the bucket rows' notes) and "a sum paid for health insurance" for the senior citizen's substitution (s.126(8)(a)): a premium, not a notified health scheme's contribution (D-145). It decides both which payments raise a bucket to its senior row and which make medical expenditure on that senior ineligible. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(2)(c), (d) first proviso, (4), to the same effect (the bucket rows' TY 2025-26 notes). Conditions only, on health.kind; provenance and introduction are DED-HEALTH-FAMILY-SENIOR's (W-156b2, D-347). Old regime only, as the health rows.
